senses.gloss: Uluvillikā, n. of a village chiefʼs daughter: LV 〔265.5〕.

ulūka-pakṣika- (in comp.; = Pali ulūka-pakkhika, AN 〔i.241.1, 296.1〕), (a dress or decoration) made of owlʼs feathers, worn by certain ascetics: Mv 〔iii.412.8〕 ˚ka-bhaginī (n. pr. acc. to Senart 〔p. xxxvii〕) śramaṇā. Cf. LV 〔249.1〕 gṛddholūkapakṣadhāraṇaiś ca (ātāpanaparitāpanaiḥ).

ullumpati (= Pali id.; Skt. herausgreifen, ˚fischen, BR.), saves, rescues: Bhīk 〔19a.3〕 ullumpatu māṃ bhadantā ubhayasaṃghaḥ (by ordination; said by the candidate); Mvy 〔8704〕 ˚patu mām (same situation; so also in Pali). [Cf. ullopana.]
